name: Light Up Viera Christmas Parade and Fireworks
when_note: Fireworks at 6 PM, parade immediately after
paras: The Brevard County Sheriff's Office and the BCSO Charity, in partnership with the Viera Company, host the Light Up Viera Christmas Parade on Saturday, November 28, from 6 PM to 8 PM. A holiday fireworks display opens the night at 6 PM and the parade starts right after.
The listing says the route runs down Stadium Parkway to Viera Boulevard and ends at Manatee Elementary, with floats, high school bands and displays. The listing marks the event as free.
tip: Fireworks start at 6 PM and the parade follows right away, so be in place before then.

name: Carols in the Park at The Avenue Viera
venue: Central Park at The Avenue Viera
when_note: December 1 to 24, performances at 6 PM and 7 PM
paras: The Avenue Viera lists Carols in the Park from December 1 to December 24, 6 PM to 8 PM, in Central Park. The host describes holiday favorites performed by local schools, choirs and community talent, with performances at 6 PM and 7 PM.
The listing does not print a price. The Avenue Viera is at 2261 Town Center Avenue, according to the Fun 4 Space Coast Kids calendar.
tip: Check the host calendar for the group singing on your night.

name: Santa Visits at The Avenue Viera
venue: Central Park at The Avenue Viera
when_note: Weekend afternoons in late November and early December, then most evenings from December 10 to 24
cost: Santa Mini Sessions $155 per 10 minutes; other visit prices not listed
paras: Santa and Mrs. Claus visit Central Park at The Avenue Viera from November 14 to December 24. This listing shows the dates from November 28 forward, with afternoon hours on weekends and evening hours on most December dates.

The Avenue Viera lists Santa Mini Sessions at $155 for 10 minutes. Each includes five professionally edited photos of your choice and an online proofing gallery delivered within seven days. The page does not print a price for the other visits.
tip: Mini sessions are booked ahead through the host's registration link.

name: FECRW Santa Train in Rockledge
paras: Santa arrives by decorated train at the FEC Rail Crossing on Gus Hipp Boulevard in Rockledge on Saturday, December 5. The listing says to be there at 2:15 PM sharp.

The event is hosted by the Rockledge Public Safety Department and Florida East Coast Railway. It is free, with gifts for children in VPK through 4th grade, photo opportunities, a Christmas village and vendors on site.
tip: The train arrives at 2:15 PM sharp, so get there before then.

name: Holiday Gnome Scavenger Hunt at Rockledge Gardens
when_note: Daily 9 AM to 5 PM, excluding holidays
paras: Rockledge Gardens runs a free holiday gnome scavenger hunt from December 1 to 30, daily from 9 AM to 5 PM, excluding holidays and during special events.

Visitors grab a map and pencil at the front entrance, find and list the name of each garden gnome, then take the finished map to the pink checkout building to claim a prize. The host says it suits all ages.
tip: Pick up the map and pencil at the front entrance.

name: Jingle Mingle at Rockledge Gardens
when_note: Film under the stars at 7 PM
paras: Jingle Mingle is an evening stroll through Rockledge Gardens on Friday, December 18, from 6 PM to 9 PM. The host lists sparkling decor, twinkling lights, a fire pit, live carolers playing festive jazz and a hidden gnome scavenger hunt.

A classic holiday film starts under the stars at 7 PM, so bring a blanket or chair. Guests who bring a new, unwrapped toy for Toys for Tots of Brevard get a coupon for a free cup of hot chocolate. The host says outside food and drinks are not permitted.
tip: Bring a blanket or chair for the 7 PM movie.
